scientific_integrity: Explicitly tied to the symmetric six-coordinate integral model. Independent verification and independent scientific review have not occurred. The correct rational-point count is diagnostic, not an infinite-field argument.
scientific_limitations: The full nonreduced Jacobian scheme at the vertex, stable reduction and moduli meaning are not determined. Earlier historical treatment may contain equivalent singular-locus information: full text of the 1990 de Jong–Shepherd-Barron–Van de Ven article could not be inspected.
title: A fifteen-line singular star in the characteristic-three symmetric Burkhardt quartic
